template.name: Minute: opening of a meeting held by email

div.style: font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #222;
div.p: Hello! This meeting is held by email: to take part, reply to this email.
You can answer until . Everybody taking part receives every answer, and each one is written into the minute as an intervention.
There is no agenda: say what you think of the subject of the email.
You can also follow it in EMS:

template.name: Minute: draft of a meeting held by email

div.style: font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #222;
div.p: The time to take part is over. Please find the draft of the minute below, for your review.

a.style: display: inline-block; background: #1a73e8; color: #ffffff; text-decoration: none; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 4px;

div.p: If anything needs correcting, reply to this email: your answer is recorded as an amendment. If everything is right, there is no need to reply.
